# Vubbs

> Run your social media. Grow your social media with AI posts that don't look AI — on autopilot.

## What Vubbs does

Vubbs is an AI social media platform that creates and publishes content for you. It writes, designs, and posts to your channels on a schedule, so a social account keeps growing without anyone touching it. The output is made to read like a human ran the account — not like generated filler.

## Platforms

Vubbs posts to Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads, and Pinterest.

## What Vubbs creates

- Posts
- Carousels
- Reels

## Auto Carousel Creator

AI-generated carousel posts, multiple slides, ready to publish.

## Proof

Built by a team that's been deep in the edit. The same pipeline has powered 25M+ views across major platforms.

## Status

Currently in private beta. Waitlist open at https://vubbs.com
